title: CrashCasino
description: A simple Crash Casino plugin that runs on Paper.
body:
## Crash Casino Plugin

**_A youtube tutorial coming soon._**

### **What does the plugin offer?**
🎰 Crash Casino – Pure adrenaline for your server!

With Crash Casino, you bring the popular crash gambling game straight to your Minecraft server! Place your bet, watch the multiplier rise – and cash out at the perfect moment before it crashes!

### 💡 How it works:

Place your bet:
Use the command
/crash bet <value>
to set your wager and join the current round.
Multiplier increases:
Once the round starts, the multiplier keeps rising (e.g. 1.00x → 2.35x → 5.80x …). The higher it goes, the bigger your potential winnings!
Cash out in time:
Use
/crash cashout or use the cashout block
to secure your winnings based on the current multiplier.
But be careful! 💥
The round can crash at any moment – if you don’t cash out before that happens, you lose your entire bet!

### 🔥 Features:

There is an adjustable config file that can modify the following things:
1. max-bet
2. countdown-seconds
3. multiplier-increase
4. crash-delay-ticks
5. instant-crash-chance
6. max-crash
7. crash-block (cashout block)
8. Language (de/en)

🎲 Will you cash out in time or risk it all?
Find out with Crash Casino!

## **Instructions**:
1. First, you need to put the plugin in your server.
2. Check if these plugins are installed: [EssentialsX](https://essentialsx.net/downloads), [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/), [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi), [FancyHolograms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fancyholograms)
3. Join your server and create a hologram with **/fholo Create text crash**.
4. Edit the first line with the placeholder **/fholo edit Crash setline 1 %crash_multiplier%**.
5. Edit the update time of the hologram with **/hologram edit Crash updatetextinterval 1**.
6. Select a cash out block by looking at a block and typing /crash setblock, when you now press it you can also cash out this way.
7. Now you can play Crash Casino with **/crash bet MONEY** or **/crash auszahlen<|>cashout**.

## Additional functions:
1. If you want a history of the games, create another hologram with the placeholder **%crash_history%** and set the update interval to 1 again
2. Use the command **/crash stats** to be notified exactly about your losses and gains.
